                <pre># Bijou AI API Changelog
        
        All notable changes to the Bijou AI WhatsApp Enterprise API will be documented in this file.
        
        The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
        and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
        
        ---
        
        ## [2.2.0] - 2026-02-15
        
        ### Added
        - **API Documentation Hub** - Comprehensive API reference with interactive testers
        - **Webhook Payload Schemas** - Detailed examples for all webhook events:
          - `message.received` - Incoming customer messages
          - `customer.created` - New customer detection
          - `escalation.created` - Human agent escalations
          - `message.sent` - AI response delivery confirmation
        - **Rate Limiting** - Per-plan request limits with headers:
          - Free: 100 req/min, 10,000/day
          - Pro: 500 req/min, 100,000/day
          - Enterprise: Unlimited
        - **Pagination Support** - Cursor and offset-based pagination for list endpoints:
          - `/api/dashboard/conversations`
          - `/api/dashboard/escalations`
          - `/api/knowledge/list`
        - **Knowledge Management API** - Document upload and management:
          - `POST /api/knowledge/upload` - Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV files
          - `GET /api/knowledge/list` - List tenant knowledge documents
          - `DELETE /api/knowledge/{document_id}` - Remove documents
        - **Multi-language support** - Automatic detection and response in:
          - English (en)
          - Bahasa Malaysia (ms)
          - Mandarin (zh)
          - Tamil (ta)
          - Manglish (en-my)
        - **Authentication Flow Diagrams** - Visual guides for Supabase JWT and token-based auth
        
        ### Changed
        - **Dashboard API** - Improved tenant isolation with `X-Tenant-ID` header enforcement
        - **Error Responses** - Standardized error format with `error_code` and `timestamp` fields
        - **Onboarding Flow** - Streamlined QR code generation with automatic session initialization
        
        ### Fixed
        - **Message deduplication** - Prevent duplicate message processing from webhook retries
        - **Conversations fallback** - Gracefully fallback to messages table when conversations empty
        - **Phone number formatting** - Consistent Malaysian phone number display (+60 XX XXX XXXX)
        
        ### Security
        - **Webhook authentication** - Added `X-Webhook-Secret` header validation for all incoming webhooks
        - **RLS policies** - Row-Level Security enforced on all Supabase tables
        - **JWT token validation** - Strict verification with 6-month rotation policy
        
        ---
        
        ## [2.1.0] - 2026-01-28
        
        ### Added
        - **Dashboard API** - Agent assist interface with conversation management
        - **Google OAuth Integration** - Connect Gmail, Calendar, and Sheets
        - **Escalation Management** - Human takeover and handoff system
        - **WhatsApp QR Linking** - Self-service WhatsApp Business API connection
        
        ### Changed
        - **Database Migration** - Switched from SQLite to Supabase PostgreSQL for scalability
        - **Environment Variables** - Consolidated config with `.env` file support
        
        ---
        
        ## [2.0.0] - 2025-12-15
        
        ### Added
        - **Multi-tenant Architecture** - Full tenant isolation with UUID-based IDs
        - **Onboarding API** - Self-service signup with WhatsApp QR code flow
        - **Supabase Integration** - Production-ready PostgreSQL backend
        - **FastAPI Framework** - Modern async Python web framework
        
        ### Breaking Changes
        - **Removed SQLite support** - All production deployments must use Supabase
        - **New authentication model** - JWT tokens replace simple API keys
        - **Tenant ID required** - All API calls must include `tenant_id` or `X-Tenant-ID` header
        
        ### Migration Guide
        1. Export existing SQLite data: `python scripts/export_sqlite.py`
        2. Create Supabase project at https://supabase.com
        3. Run migration: `python scripts/migrate_to_supabase.py`
        4. Update environment variables with new `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY`
        5. Test onboarding flow with new tenant signup endpoint
        
        ---
        
        ## [1.5.0] - 2025-11-01
        
        ### Added
        - **Voice TTS Support** - Text-to-speech responses via Azure/Google TTS
        - **Media Handling** - Image, video, document processing with Gemini Vision
        - **Tool Orchestration** - Structured function calling for external integrations
        
        ### Changed
        - **AI Model** - Upgraded from Gemini 1.5 Flash to Gemini 2.5 Flash for better performance
        - **Cost Optimization** - Automatic key rotation to avoid rate limits
        
        ---
        
        ## [1.0.0] - 2025-09-15
        
        ### Added
        - **Initial Release** - WhatsApp Business API integration
        - **TRACE Framework** - ASI (empathy detection) + CAE (contextual response) + ERS (escalation routing)
        - **Multi-language Detection** - Automatic language identification
        - **Human Escalation** - Manual agent takeover
        - **Basic Dashboard** - Conversation monitoring
        
        ---
        
        ## Deprecation Notices
        
        ### v3.0.0 (Planned: 2026-08-31)
        - **DEPRECATED:** Dashboard token authentication (`?token=...`) will be removed in favor of JWT-only auth
        - **MIGRATION:** Switch to Supabase JWT authentication by 2026-06-30
        - **DEPRECATED:** Offset-based pagination will default to cursor-based for better performance
        
        ---
        
        ## Version Support Policy
        
        | Version | Status | Support Until | Security Fixes |
        |---------|--------|---------------|----------------|
        | 2.2.x   | ✅ Active | Current | Yes |
        | 2.1.x   | ⚠️ Maintenance | 2026-07-15 | Yes |
        | 2.0.x   | ⚠️ Maintenance | 2026-06-15 | Critical only |
        | 1.x.x   | ❌ End of Life | 2026-03-31 | No |
        
        ---
        
        ## How to Stay Updated
        
        - **GitHub Releases:** https://github.com/w3jconsulting/bijou-ai/releases
        - **API Status Page:** https://status.bijou.ai (coming soon)
        - **Developer Newsletter:** Subscribe at https://bijou.ai/developers
        
        ---
        
        ## Questions?
        
        Contact us:
        - 📧 Email: w3jdev@gmail.com
        - 💬 WhatsApp: +60 11 6060 0963 (W3J Support)
        - 🌐 Website: https://w3jconsulting.com
        
        ---
        
        **Built with ❤️ by W3J Consulting**
        </pre>
